annotations.title: Render debug views of a pose

description:
Render one pose as a grid of debug views next to the beauty pass: lighting only, albedo, world normals, overdraw and wireframe. Shows why a shot looks wrong.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/debug-views"}

aspect.description: Frame width/height (default 1.7778 = 16:9). Every tile uses it.

bookmark_name.description: Pose from a camera bookmark (summer_engine_save_camera_bookmark (list: summer_engine_list_camera_bookmarks)). Use INSTEAD of camera_position/camera_look_at.

camera_look_at.description: Explicit pose: point the camera looks at, "Vector3(x, y, z)".

camera_position.description: Explicit pose: camera position, "Vector3(x, y, z)". Goes with camera_look_at.

fov.description: Vertical field of view in degrees (1..179). Default: the bookmark's own, or 60.

max_size.description: Longest edge of the returned JPEG in pixels (default 1536). Bigger costs more context; up to 4096 for detail work on a PC.

save_to.description: Also write the returned image to res://.summer/shots/saved/<name>.jpg (1-64 of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -; needs max_size <= 1024).

scenePath.description: Scene to look at, e.g. "res://levels/town.tscn" (the SAVED file). Omit for the scene open in the editor.

update_previous.description: bookmark_name only: replace the bookmark's previous image (compare baseline) with this beauty tile. Default false: only a missing slot is created.

views.description: Which views, in grid order (default all six: beauty, lighting, unshaded, normals, overdraw, wireframe).

name: summer_debug_views
title: Render debug views of a pose
